consent.title: Your data
consent.body: {{society}} uses Society App to manage bills, payments, complaints and notices. We store your name, email, phone and flat details for this, share them only with your society's committee, and keep financial records as the law requires. You can ask your committee to correct your details, and request deletion of your account.
